The first season of a rebuild will test first-year Bulls coach Tiago Splitter.

Here's what we learned in the weeks leading up to Wednesday’s regular-season opener.
2026-27 Chicago Bulls schedule gets real, and so do questions about the roster (via Pippen Ain't Easy)

Chicago Bulls 2026-27 predictions:
11) Noa Essengue plays more minutes than Dailyn Swain

Both should clock a lot of minutes at Windy City this season, but I think Essengue’s freakish body gives him more opportunities with the big club, especially on defense.

Chicago Bulls 2026-27 predictions:
10) Josh Giddey finishes top-5 for assists.

This would push him above 10.0 APG, which he has never exceeded. I’m not a fan, but if any Bull is going to stuff their stat sheet this year, it’s Giddey. This team should run, & he rebounds + outlet passes

Chicago Bulls 2026-27 predictions:
9) Caleb Wilson will have 30+ more dunks than any other Bull.

Last season, Matas led the team with 79 dunks (36th in NBA). East to beat. BUT the Bulls acquired Nic Claxton, who had 125 (11th). Can Caleb dunk 150+ times & be top-7 in the NBA?

Chicago Bulls 2026-27 predictions:
8) Caleb Wilson is top 2 for Rookie of the Year. 

I expect Cameron Boozer to win, but I have high hopes for Caleb. He should be a highlight reel, and if he isn’t totally lost on defense (big “if”) he should outpace the other 2 drafted ahead of him

Chicago Bulls 2026-27 predictions:
7) Patrick Williams plays <9.0 MPG

He sucks & should be the last guy off the bench. There is a lot of depth in his position, and his defensive mobility fell off a cliff. No chance of trading him, so why play him?

Chicago Bulls 2026-27 predictions:
6) Noa Essengue plays >30 games

This seemed unlikely when he was benched in Summer League, but I think he’ll be up & down from the G-League all year. Splitter claims to want ~12 man rotation, & Essengue is a dog on point of attack, so maybe?

Chicago Bulls 2026-27 predictions:
5) Matas Buzelis averages >7.0 3PA per game & >.350 3P%

Matas claims to want to shoot more mid-range shots this year, and maybe he does. But I think this team is going to chuck 3s, so his 3PA will increase even with more middies

Chicago Bulls 2026-27 predictions:
4) Matas Buzelis has more turnovers than assists (again).

He was barely negative last year in his A/TO ration, but I expect his usage to go up and for him to make more halfcourt decsions. And with that, more errors. That’s fine, he’s young!

Chicago Bulls 2026-27 predictions:
3) Leonard Miller plays more minutes for the Bulls than Nic Claxton. 

I’m predicting Claxton to miss a lot of time (~30 games) with nagging injuries. And why not rest him? They’re not competing. 

This may wind up close if I’m right that Miller gets traded

Chicago Bulls 2026-27 predictions: 
2a) even if the Bulls trade all 3, they don’t get any lottery picks. 

This is less of a judgement against these players (I think Miller could sign an Ayo-like extension with his new team), and more of doubt in the new Bulls front office.

Chicago Bulls 2026-27 predictions:
2) two of Buddy Hield, Leonard Miller, & Norm Powell are traded by the deadline. Miller & Powell are UFAs and will have the chance to pad their stats and appeal to a contender. Hield has a $10mm player option, but only $3.3mm is guaranteed. Easy trade bait.

Chicago Bulls 2026-27 predictions:
1) Season record: 27-55
The over-under is currently 29.5, but I think the Bulls are going to be active at the deadline. That, plus the presumed scarcity of tanking teams, means the Bulls won’t have another mickey mouse March to salvage their record
